title: Subscription · reading
blurb: One monthly fee, a catalogue instead of a purchase. Cheap per book if you read a lot, expensive if you do not.

items.d: Millions of self-published and backlist titles, borrowed rather than bought.
Ebooks, audiobooks and magazines from the old Scribd catalogue.
Academic and professional books by subscription, aimed at students.
A smaller catalogue with a free tier and no lock-in.
Ebooks and audiobooks in one app, strongest in the Nordic languages.
Reading and listening in one place, with a large Russian and Spanish shelf.
